senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. חטט)to cut the throat, esp. to slay an animal by cutting the throat according to ritual laws.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 1:1">Ḥull. I, 1</cite> <he>הכל שׁוֹחֲטִין וכ׳</he> all persons are fit to do the ritual slaughtering, and their act is legal, except &c.; <he>וכולן ששָׁחֲטוּ וכ׳</he> and all those (mentioned as unfit), if they cut under the supervision of others &c. Ib. II, 3 <he>היה שׁוֹחֵט והתיז וכ׳</he> if he was cutting (drawing the knife across the throat, v. <cite ref="U00635">preced.</cite>) and cut the head off with one movement. Ib. 1 <he>השוחט … ושנים וכ׳</he> if one cuts one organ (windpipe or gullet, v. <cite ref="O00710"><he>סִימָן</he></cite>) of a bird, and two &c.; ib. <he>עד שיִשְׁחוֹט וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="F00093"><he>וָרִיד</he></cite>; a. fr.—Part. pass. <he>שָׁחוּט</he>; f. <he>שְׁחוּטָה</he> &c.
<cite ref="Niddah 15a:33">Nidd. 15ᵃ</cite> <he>שור ש׳ לפניך</he> the ox lies slaughtered before thee, i.e. the evidence is before you.
<cite ref="Chullin 95a:7">Ḥull. 95ᵃ</cite> <he>בְּשַׂר ש׳</he> meat of an animal ritually cut, opp. <he>בשר נבלה</he>; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to be cut, killed according to ritual. Ib. 9ᵃ עד … במה נִשְׁחֲטָה, v. חֲזָקָה. Ib. נשחטה הרי היא וכ׳ if it has been properly slaughtered, it is presumed to be permitted until &c.; a. fr.
to cause to slaughter. Ib. V, 4 בארבע … מַשְׁחִיטִין את הטבח וכ׳ at these four periods we force the butcher to slaughter (provide meat); Erub. 81ᵇ
